lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns of two to three nodes along the posterior flank and caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance nodes to form a grid-like arrangement on the posterior third of the shark.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the lateral midline, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation on the leading edge of the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
